description: Two-channel process indicator with four alarm relays, two LEDs and two retransmission outputs (voltage, current, RTD), with RS-232 or RS-485 Modbus RTU
source: Presys, DMY-2030-Energy, Manual (section 5, Modbus registers and coils)
notes: Section 5 lists registers 0 to 118 and coils 1 to 107. It does not say whether the numbers are the addresses sent on the wire or are numbered from 1; they are taken as the wire addresses (address_base 0, the first register is number 00). If a read is off by one, try address_base 1.

The document says the connection details are in a separate communication manual. Slave address (0 to 99), baud rate (300 to 9600 bps) and parity are set in registers 7, 9 and 10; the factory defaults are not given, so 9600 bps, no parity and slave 1 are placeholders. The optional communication module is RS-232 or RS-485.

Values shown with a decimal point on the display are sent without it. Only the digital filter constant and the relay delays (one decimal, 0.1 s) are scaled here; the process variables, setpoints and hysteresis values depend on the decimals of their channel (registers 17 and 18) and are given raw. Percent values (limits, signal on failure) are given raw as well.
The document does not say which Modbus function reads the registers; they are taken as holding registers.
The document numbers coils 1 to 107 with gaps (33, 41, 49, 57, 65, 74, 75 and others); the numbers that are not listed are not mapped.
Written from the manufacturer's document; not tested on a device.

trip_state.1: Release (the contact goes to the no-alarm position)
